headline: Cheaper Electricity Rates for Heat Pump Owners in Massachusetts
subheading: Massachusetts was the first state to cut winter electricity rates for homes that heat with a heat pump. Here's how the discount works, what it saved last winter, and why it's getting bigger.
seoTitle: Massachusetts Heat Pump Rates: How the Winter Discount Works
description: Massachusetts heat pump owners saved $37 million last winter on discounted electricity rates, and the discount grows this winter. How it works and who qualifies.
